message.reasoning: We need to answer based on policy excerpts. The question: "I need this seat swap done before our next invoice generates so we don't get double-billed — how do I do it correctly?" This relates to seat reassignment and billing. Relevant excerpt: DOC-029: "The next invoice bills the seat count as of the invoice date, so a same-cycle reassignment shows as one seat, not two." So answer: explain that you can reassign seat before invoice date; the next invoice will count only one seat. Possibly also mention invoice date shown in Settings → Billing → Plan next to “Next invoice”. But main is seat swap before invoice to avoid double billing. Provide steps: go to seat management, reassign seat, ensure done before invoice date. Also mention invoice date location. Use DOC-007 for invoice date location. So answer: go to Seats → reassign, ensure before next invoice date; next invoice will only bill one seat. Provide that you can check next invoice date in Settings → Billing → Plan. That's within policy. So we can post reply.

function.arguments: {"message":"You can reassign the seat any time before the next invoice date and you won’t be double‑billed. The invoice will count the seat count as of the invoice date, so a same‑cycle reassignment is billed as a single seat. To be sure you’re within the window, check the exact invoice date in Settings → Billing → Plan (look for “Next invoice”). Once you’ve moved the seat in the seat‑management screen before that date, the next invoice will reflect the new seat count correctly."}

arguments.message: You can reassign the seat any time before the next invoice date and you won’t be double‑billed. The invoice will count the seat count as of the invoice date, so a same‑cycle reassignment is billed as a single seat. To be sure you’re within the window, check the exact invoice date in Settings → Billing → Plan (look for “Next invoice”). Once you’ve moved the seat in the seat‑management screen before that date, the next invoice will reflect the new seat count correctly.
